newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Progressive raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Progressive raised to buy.

text.p: -- CS First Boston raised its rating on Progressive Corp to a buy from its previous rating of hold.
-- Analyst Charles Gates was not immediately available for comment.

-- Gates later said he raised the rating because of Progressive's strong earnings posted after the market close on Tuesday. The company reported net earnings per share of $1.08 compared with $0.81 last year.
-- "They were much better than what we were looking for; they had strong growth in sales and very favorable underwriting results," he said.
-- He raised his 1996 profit estimate to $4 a share from a prior estimate of $3.75 and 1997 per share estimate to $4.70 from $4.20.
-- Gates also cited the rollout of the company's 1-800-AUTO-PRO program in Connecticut, Michigan and Pennsylvania.
